x: On their next appearance they had covered about 3 miles, and Roberts, of Mitcham, was leading by a few yards from Isted, of Westerham ,and Shirley, of Ashcombe.

Early points were piled up by Reg Hopkins who placed 2nd over 400mH to Hillingdon's Shirley and then won the long jump. Alan Black cantered to an easy 5000m win and Paul Whitby again scored heavily in the high hurdles.

We had the usual backing of non-scorers and for the first time four of our ladies took to the road (unofficially of course!) and Shirley, Anna, Diane and Jane impressed us all by their determined walking.
